institution: KSCSTE- Malabar Botanical Garden & Institute for Plant Sciences (MBGIPS)
problem_solved: Proliferation of the invasive strawflower (Xerochrysum bracteatum) threatening native biodiversity in regions like the Nilgiris, combined with the high environmental footprint of synthetic/plastic gifts.
description: An eco-friendly corporate and academic memento/hamper handcrafted from locally sourced dried flora and foliage. The primary material utilizes the vibrant, long-lasting petals of the invasive strawflower, converting an ecological threat into a value-added consumer product. The manufacturing process is entirely manual, chemical-free, and designed for decentralized production by local women's self-help groups.
applications:
• Sustainable corporate gifting and institutional mementos for events

• Souvenirs for eco-tourism hubs, botanical gardens, and heritage sites

• Commercial handcrafted decoration and sustainable FMCG lifestyle products

• Green skill development and rural livelihood programs
